proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A X H K hX hH hK h1 h2
  have s1 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := X) (p₂ := H) (p₃ := A) h1
  have s2 := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := X) (p₂ := K) (p₃ := A) h2
  have l1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_div_two_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := X) (p₂ := H) (p₃ := A) h1 hH
  have l2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_div_two_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := X) (p₂ := K) (p₃ := A) h2 hK
  have n1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg H A X
  have n2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg K A X
  have hd : dist X A ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hX.symm
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← s1, ← s2, h]
  · intro h
    rw [← s1, ← s2] at h
    exact Real.injOn_sin ⟨by linarith, l1.le⟩ ⟨by linarith, l2.le⟩ (mul_right_cancel₀ hd h)
